overview_description.description:
Fond is a SaaS platform that seamlessly consolidates employee rewards and recognition processes into one easy-to-use solution. With Fond, employees and managers can recognize each other, redeem rewards, access exclusive corporate discounts, and measure success so HR departments spend less time managing programs and more time driving results.

Fond is headquartered in San Francisco, California. Learn more at https://www.fond.co.

about_short_description.short_description: Fond is a SaaS platform that makes it easy to use and manage employee rewards and recognition programs.

product.name: Social Recognition
product.description: A platform feature that enables employees to publicly acknowledge colleagues for milestones and accomplishments to foster a culture of recognition.

product.name: Service Awards
product.description: A tool to create and manage custom service award catalogs, track employee work anniversaries, and offer physical awards like plaques and trophies.

product.name: Performance Analytics
product.description: A reporting tool that tracks program performance, usage, redemption history, and popular perks and rewards to monitor employee engagement.

product.name: Corporate Discounts
product.description: Access to pre-negotiated corporate perks including discounts on entertainment, fitness, and travel, available to employees without additional company effort.
